senses.gloss: ऐणेय mfn. (fr. एणी), produced or coming from the female black antelope, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 159; ĀśvGṛ.; Suśr.; BhP. &c.
(fr. ऐणेय) belonging to anything which is produced from the female black antelope, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 155
ऐणेय n. a kind of coitus.
ऐणेय-जङ्घता f. having legs like those of a deer (one of the 32 signs of perfection), Dharmas. 83.
